name: varg-sdk
description: vargHQ SDK — declarative React/JSX engine for AI video generation. Compose videos using <Image>, <Video>, <Speech>, <Music>, <Captions> components backed by fal.ai, ElevenLabs, Replicate, Groq.

install.step3: Install deps: bun install vargai ai
install.step5: Render a video: bunx vargai render video.tsx

capabilities.image-generation: fal.ai Flux models (flux-pro, nano-banana-pro) + Higgsfield Soul
capabilities.video-generation: Kling v2.5, Wan 2.5 via fal.ai (text-to-video, image-to-video)
capabilities.music-generation: ElevenLabs music + sound effects from prompts
capabilities.video-editing: ffmpeg-based resize, trim, concat, social media format prep
capabilities.web-scraping: Apify actors (TikTok trends, Google Maps, social media)

security_review.notes: TypeScript SDK. Shell scripts are pure ffmpeg wrappers. Bun.spawn used only for local test execution and browser URL opening. No remote code execution, no eval of network content, no obfuscated code. Developer .claude/settings.local.json NOT copied.
